settings.description: A fictional independent studio helping neighbourhood businesses plan accessible, mobile-friendly websites, online stores and local search improvements. We also provide website care and content support. Projects begin with a conversation about customers, existing tools and priorities; scope is agreed before work begins.

leads.name: Sarah Chen
leads.inquiry_message: Our bakery website is slow on mobile, and customers struggle to find the weekly menu. We would like online ordering for Saturday pickup, including a way to choose a collection time. We have new product photos ready but want to keep our existing domain.
leads.notes: Fictional demo lead. Ask which ordering system they currently use.

leads.name: Michael Brown
leads.inquiry_message: Our bicycle repair shop recently moved, and the old address still appears in search results. We want nearby riders to find our tune-up services rather than just our retail page. Could you review our local search presence and service pages?
leads.notes: Fictional demo lead. Initial reply discussed business profile and address listings.

leads.name: Olivia Taylor
leads.inquiry_message: We sell illustrated stationery at local markets and would like an online store for about forty products. Some items have colour options, and we need both shipping and local pickup. Our inventory lives in a spreadsheet; can that be a starting point?
leads.notes: Fictional demo lead. Sent questions about inventory and checkout preferences.

leads.name: Daniel Lee
leads.inquiry_message: Our WordPress portfolio needs plugin updates and a clearer backup routine. We add project photos monthly but are nervous after an update broke a gallery. Could we discuss maintenance and who would handle content edits?
leads.notes: Fictional demo lead. Replied with their WordPress version and requested a discovery call.

leads.name: Avery Wilson
leads.inquiry_message: Our pottery workshop pages are hard to navigate on phones. Visitors need to find class descriptions and the booking link without searching through our gallery. We already have a booking platform and would prefer to keep it.
leads.notes: Fictional demo lead. Scope agreed offline; owner marked the project won.

leads.name: Jordan Ellis
leads.inquiry_message: Our bookshop has a large events archive, but current author talks are difficult to find in search. We are interested in an SEO audit focused on structure and event pages. We want to understand the issues before deciding on a redesign.
leads.notes: Fictional demo lead. Paused the project; no further outreach requested.

leads.name: Priya Shah
leads.inquiry_message: Our floral gallery loads slowly on mobile connections. Wedding clients arrive from social media and cannot find the inquiry form. Could you look at image sizes and how the contact page works on phones?
leads.notes: Fictional demo lead. Waiting for a link to their gallery.

leads.name: Noah Brooks
leads.inquiry_message: Our studio timetable is a PDF that is awkward to read on phones. We would like an accessible class schedule and a clearer link to our booking tool. Can we discuss a redesign our small team can update?
leads.notes: Fictional demo lead. New website form inquiry.

simulated_inquiries.name: Emma Rivera
simulated_inquiries.inquiry_message: We take lunch platter orders by phone and would like online ordering for office pickups. Each platter has dietary options, and customers need to select a collection date. Could we discuss a flow our kitchen team can manage?
simulated_inquiries.notes: Fictional simulated inquiry; no email is sent.

simulated_inquiries.name: Liam Patel
simulated_inquiries.inquiry_message: Our repair studio has incorrect opening hours in local search. We also want our service area to be clearer to nearby customers. Could you review our business profile and suggest which details to gather?
simulated_inquiries.notes: Fictional simulated inquiry; no email is sent.

simulated_inquiries.name: Zoe Martin
simulated_inquiries.inquiry_message: Our WordPress gallery stopped displaying thumbnails after a plugin update. We have a backup but are unsure how to test a restore safely. We would like to discuss maintenance and adding new collections.
simulated_inquiries.notes: Fictional simulated inquiry; no email is sent.
